title: Typhoon signal in Hong Kong unlikely in next 2 days but expect unsettled weather

article.title: Typhoon signal in Hong Kong unlikely in next 2 days but expect unsettled weather
article.summary: The likelihood that Hong Kong’s weather forecaster will issue a typhoon signal in the next two days is “relatively low”, although multiple tropical cyclones are set to bring unsettled weather to the city later this week.
